findings.title: Single-host concentration: host loss is total pipeline loss
evidence: compose/central/docker-compose.yml single central stack; no warm standby
REAUDIT_REPORT_202604: ARCH-P1-001 still-open, genuine large effort
findings.recommendation: Add a warm standby or a documented, tested RTO/RPO acceptance with owner sign-off.
findings.detail: Add a warm standby or a documented, tested RTO/RPO acceptance with owner sign-off.

findings.title: Declared container hardening lags the running containers
findings.recommendation: Bring declared security_opt/read_only/cap_drop in compose to parity with live and gate it.
findings.detail: Bring declared security_opt/read_only/cap_drop in compose to parity with live and gate it.

findings.title: Wazuh and vendored MCT stacks run tag-only images outside pin/SBOM scope
findings.recommendation: Extend pins/images.lock + SBOM coverage to Wazuh/MCT or scope the waiver per ref.
findings.detail: Extend pins/images.lock + SBOM coverage to Wazuh/MCT or scope the waiver per ref.

findings.title: Live ingest authentication is a shared secret header, not mTLS
findings.recommendation: Move edge→aggregator ingest to certificate/mTLS identity or add request signing + idempotency.
findings.detail: Move edge→aggregator ingest to certificate/mTLS identity or add request signing + idempotency.
